Theorem
[Existence of minimizers, polyconvex functionals] ↗ thm:lower-semicontinuity-polyconvex ↗ def:admissible-class-systems 1. ch8:8.2-thm-9\group Existence of Minimizers

Assume that $n < q < \infty $, and that $L$ satisfies the coercivity inequality (43) and is polyconvex. Suppose also the admissible set $\mathcal{A}$ is nonempty.

Then there exists $u \in \mathcal{A}$ solving \[ I[u] = \min _{w \in \mathcal{A}} I[w]. \]
